data.name: DBWorld e-mails
data.abstract: It contains 64 e-mails which I have manually collected from DBWorld mailing list. They are classified in: 'announces of conferences' and 'everything else'.

additional_info.summary: I collected 64 e-mails from DBWorld newsletter and I used them to train different algorithms in order to classify between 'announces of conferences' and 'everything else'. I used a binary bag-of-words representation with a stopword removal pre-processing task before.
additional_info.variable_info: Each attribute corresponds to a precise word or stem in the entire data set vocabulary (I used bag-of-words representation).
